senses.gloss:
चुमुरि चुमुरि, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a hostile
demon whom Indra, to favour Dabhīti, sent to sleep.

चुम्ब् 1. चुम्ब्, cl. 1. P. चुम्बति, चुचुम्ब,
चुम्बिष्यति, चुम्बितुम्, to kiss, touch
with the mouth; touch softly or lightly, graze: Caus.
P. चुम्बयति, -यितुम्, to cause to kiss; [cf. Goth.
kukja; Hib. pogaim; Lith. bucioju; Lett. sz-
kûpstit.]

चुम्ब् 2. चुम्ब्, cl. 10. P. चुम्बयति, &c.,
to hurt, kill.
चुम्ब, अस्, आ, m. f. kissing, a kiss.

चुम्बक, अस्, इका, अम्, a kisser, one who kisses
much; a lecher; knavish, roguish, a rogue, a cheat;
one who has read much, a superficial scholar who
knows parts in a variety of books; (अस्), m. a load-
stone; the upper part or middle of a balance.

चुम्बन, अम्, n. kissing, a kiss.
—चुम्बन-
दान, अम्, n. giving a kiss, kissing.

चुम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, kissed, touched softly or
lightly.
—चुम्बित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has
kissed; kissing.

चुम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, kissing; touching closely or
softly, grazing.
